items.title: ​HSA/FSA for 24/7 Pediatric Telehealth: Pay Tax-Free for Blueberry Pediatrics
items.summary: Blueberry Pediatrics' membership fee is now a qualified medical expense, allowing families to pay for their 24/7 virtual pediatric care using pre-tax funds from their Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending Account (FSA). This eligibility, based on the Direct Primary Care (DPC) model and clarified by recent federal legislation (including a key provision effective January 1, 2026, which ensures HSA contributions are not compromised), offers significant financial advantages such as tax savings and cost predictability. At only $216 annually, the fixed fee provides unlimited access to a pediatrician, avoiding the high costs of deductibles or an average $850 ER co-pay, and the at-home diagnostic kit is also generally covered.

items.title: Building the agent was never the hard part: the build-vs-buy conundrum
